title: First run makes transport architecture the first decision
observed: Five large surfaces present demo, computer, Tailscale, Termux and guide; a sixth external-agent action occupies a persistent footer. Location, transport and learning choices have similar visual rank.
impact: A developer must classify infrastructure before seeing a clear next step.
proposal: One filled Connect to a server action and a quiet Try demo; discoverable More setup options expands existing platform-gated routes.
verification: Focused behavior checks pass with pinned Shorebird Flutter3.47.2;12 synthetic real-widget screenshots in docs/qa/simple-first-run, 1080x2400 DPR2.625 light/dark1x/2x. No modified APK runtime proof.

title: Border and icon-tile repetition flattens hierarchy
observed: Every setup path uses a 72dp minimum card, 40dp colored icon tile, 22dp icon and trailing chevron. Demo also has a full-width outline. The frame border repeats around almost every choice.
impact: Scanning recognizes repeated containers before distinguishing useful decisions; advanced tools feel as important as connection.
proposal: Remove the card grid and decorative icon tiles. Keep a filled primary button and unboxed secondary rows; use disclosure only for setup options.
verification: Focused behavior checks pass with pinned Shorebird Flutter3.47.2;12 synthetic real-widget screenshots in docs/qa/simple-first-run, 1080x2400 DPR2.625 light/dark1x/2x. No modified APK runtime proof.

title: Different content rails weaken alignment
observed: Welcome uses 20dp outer padding, cards then introduce list-tile insets and 40dp icon columns; header/footer use separate 16dp rails. Centered hero text and left-aligned three-line rows change reading alignment.
impact: The first screen has multiple competing alignment systems and a ragged rhythm.
proposal: Use one 24dp content rail, left-aligned heading/body, full-width button, and zero-inset advanced list rows. Keep app bar standard.
verification: Focused behavior checks pass with pinned Shorebird Flutter3.47.2;12 synthetic real-widget screenshots in docs/qa/simple-first-run, 1080x2400 DPR2.625 light/dark1x/2x. No modified APK runtime proof.

title: Premature keyboard hides authentication context
observed: New server URL autofocus opens the keyboard immediately while pairing controls are still offered. The screenshot shows authentication cut off at the username field.
impact: The user is pushed into typing before deciding whether to scan/paste; authentication and consequences are below the keyboard.
proposal: No autofocus for a new address, including Codex endpoint. Preserve explicit password/token re-entry autofocus because the chosen task is already credential repair.
verification: Focused behavior checks pass with pinned Shorebird Flutter3.47.2;12 synthetic real-widget screenshots in docs/qa/simple-first-run, 1080x2400 DPR2.625 light/dark1x/2x. No modified APK runtime proof.

title: Save label conceals connection side effect
observed: Save server/Save action invokes save plus connect for new and active profiles. Codex already says Save & connect.
impact: The same button wording suggests storage only yet can change live connection state.
proposal: Save & connect for new, active or Codex; Save changes for inactive OpenCode edits. Keep truthful saved-but-not-connected failure and dirty draft protection.

title: Header submit competes with title and is far from thumb
observed: Add server and Save server share one app-bar row; compact mode shortens the action to Save.
impact: Large text needs room and the label loses scope when shortened. One-handed reach is poor.
proposal: Full-width bottom action uses explicit scope at every width and rises above keyboard; editor fields remain scrollable.

title: Demo disappears after the first connection
observed: ServersScreen only renders the demo callback in the empty-profile branch. Demo itself uses an isolated controller/store and does not require profiles to be deleted.
impact: Users cannot safely relearn review or show the app after setup through the same entry point.
proposal: Expose Try demo in the saved-server list, preserving route-owned ephemeral state and owner profile data.

title: Demo teaches three tasks simultaneously
observed: The wrapper has simulation header/disclosure, nested chat has another app bar, generic Start coding suggestions differ from the prefilled welcome-message task.
impact: The demonstration asks a novice to choose among prepared prompt, generic suggestions and slash-command lesson before the first result.
proposal: One explicit demo chat empty state and one navigation header, with persistent simulation truth. Requires coordinated chat-library change.
verification: Explicit demo presentation seam agreed; Chat journey owner implements showAppBar and emptyState options plus DemoScreen callsite together.

title: Remote address example is incomplete and long
observed: The input hint is 192.0.2.20:4096 or https://… while helper text recommends HTTPS. The screenshot truncates the example.
impact: A novice must infer whether to add a scheme and sees an ellipsis as part of an address example.
proposal: Use https://server.example as one complete example. Retain URL normalization, localhost rules and real TLS/auth validation.

title: Recovery assumes the hosting method from loopback
observed: The baseline failure page promotes Check Termux for a loopback endpoint although an ADB/SSH tunnel can also use loopback.
impact: The prominent remedy may direct the user into an unrelated setup instead of retrying their existing connection.
proposal: Lead with known failure, Retry and Change connection; place hosting-specific advice in troubleshoot unless supported by evidence. Shared recovery owner notified.
verification: Focused behavior checks pass with pinned Shorebird Flutter3.47.2;12 synthetic real-widget screenshots in docs/qa/simple-first-run, 1080x2400 DPR2.625 light/dark1x/2x. No modified APK runtime proof.

title: No motion or performance proof from static polish
observed: Setup navigation uses MaterialPageRoute; proposed disclosure uses framework ExpansionTile. No measured frame timeline or task completion data exists for this slice.
impact: Fluidity cannot honestly be certified by visual screenshots or line count.
proposal: Keep native route/expansion behavior and capture reduced motion plus device interaction after integration; do not add blur or decorative animations to setup.
verification: Baseline screenshot and source inspected; no modified APK runtime proof.

title: Connection type and pairing still precede manual fields
observed: After repair, the keyboard stays closed and auth is visible, but connection-type chips and pairing instructions still consume the top of the editor. OpenCode/Codex selection remains a visible technical choice.
impact: A user entering a known URL still scans pairing and protocol setup before reaching the form.
proposal: Evaluate pairing-first/manual-entry disclosure in a subsequent focused journey without obscuring experimental Codex or weakening credential validation.
verification: Observed in final synthetic capture; deliberately not expanded beyond the approved repair slice.
